dicate` is evaluated against the\n PERSISTED transcript, so a stored run can be re-graded against it\n month
s later; a `WidgetAssertion` is evaluated against a LIVE DOM\n and can never be replayed. Calling this a check would pr

omise the
 replayability only one half of it has.
